landing.metaTitle: Vow – the wedding planner for couples marrying across borders
landing.metaDescription: Your guests fly in from everywhere. Vow gives every guest their own trip page, in their language, with flights, rooms, seating and entry paperwork — all in one place.
landing.title: Your guests fly in from everywhere. Vow gets them there.
landing.intro: One planner for the couple, the family abroad and every guest: travel, rooms, seating, paperwork and the website, in everyone’s own language.
landing.differenceTitle: What other wedding apps don’t do
landing.differenceText: Built for weddings where guests cross borders, not just state lines.

trip.title: Personal trip page
trip.text: Every guest gets their own page: flights, hotel room, shuttle time, table number, and a checklist of what to bring.

entry.title: Entry checklist for every guest
entry.text: Passport, visa and travel permit steps for the country you marry in, matched to each guest’s home country, whichever continent they fly in from.

rooms.title: Hotel room board
rooms.text: Block rooms across hotels, assign guests, track who’s confirmed and who still needs a bed.

shuttle.title: Shuttle planner
shuttle.text: Group arrivals by time, plan pickups, and let guests know when their ride leaves.

paperwork.title: Marriage paperwork
paperwork.text: The documents you need to legally marry in 64 countries: apostilles, translations, deadlines, all tracked.

languages.title: 25 languages per guest
languages.text: Your Slovenian grandma sees everything in Slovenian. Your college friends see it in English. Automatic.

landing.featuresText: Every part of your plan talks to the others. RSVPs flow into the seating chart, booked venues flow into your website.

guests.title: Guest list
guests.text: Households, sides, dietary needs and CSV import in minutes.

rsvp.title: RSVPs
rsvp.text: One private link per household. Answers arrive live.

seating.title: Seating chart
seating.text: Drag guests onto seats. Keep families together, exes apart.

budget.title: Budget
budget.text: Categories, deposits and due dates, with no surprises.

venues.title: Venues & vendors
venues.text: Compare side by side, then book with confidence.

travel.title: Hotels & travel
travel.text: Room blocks, flights and an arrivals board for pickups.

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.text: Pin ideas, pull colour palettes and decide together.

website.title: Wedding website
website.text: Five beautiful templates with RSVP built in.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: A to-do plan from twelve months out to the big day.

languages.title: 25 languages
languages.text: You plan in your language; every guest gets the website, RSVP and emails in theirs.

landing.closingTitle: Your wedding crosses borders. Your planner should too.
landing.closingText: Invite your partner, parents or planner, and plan it all together in real time — no matter where everyone lives.

mock.passport: Passport valid until at least June 2027

landing.marquee: Every guest reads Vow in their own language

pricing.title: Free to plan your wedding
pricing.text: No trial, no card. Everything on this page is included.
pricing.priceNote: for the couple, the family and every guest

includes.guests: Guest list, RSVPs and seating chart
includes.trip: A trip page for every guest
includes.family: Plan together with family and your planner

free.a: Yes. You can plan your whole wedding in Vow, with your family and every guest, without paying.

guests.q: Do our guests need an account?
guests.a: No. Each household gets its own private link and code. They open it to reply, pick a meal and see their trip page.

languages.a: 25, including Slovenian, German, Croatian, Spanish and Arabic. Each guest sees their RSVP, trip page and emails in their own language.

family.a: Yes. Invite your partner, parents, planner or helpers. Each gets the right access, and everyone sees changes as they happen.

phone.q: Does it work on a phone?
phone.a: Yes. Vow is built for phones first, for you and for guests opening their link at the airport.

privacy.q: What happens to our guests’ data?
privacy.a: Only you and the people you invite can see it. Guests can see what you have saved about them and delete it themselves.
